source: MAFF / ADB, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Bean crop — mung bean and black gram], official cultivation manual, 2005 (mung bean sections)
text: Shared pest and disease coverage across both mung bean and black gram in this manual includes: Cercospora leaf spot, powdery mildew, and mosaic virus disease; and aphid, cutworm, bean pod borer, leaf-footed bug/stink bug complex, whitefly, and mealybug as the main insect pests, each with identification and control notes plus named pesticide-use guidance for chemical control options.
